evaluation_definition.extraction_case_pass: all expected facts in eligible fields match at least one validator-accepted model candidate and no explicitly forbidden positive candidate occurs; independent of integrated pass and fallback
evaluation_definition.integrated_case_pass: all original fixed scenario expectations pass against the application session, including safety/triage/stage/questions and rule fallback

evaluation_definition.candidate_oracle_limit: unlisted candidate fields are oracle_unspecified, not assumed false; only explicit forbidden_positive entries count as explicit unsupported-positive candidates
evaluation_definition.fact_filtering: quote, value, negation, field-evidence, and unsupported-status proposals rejected per field are separately listed and included in all-response proposal counts; extraction coverage uses only validator-accepted facts
